title: SAP ISU DM Consultant
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* A day in the life of an Infoscion
* Serve as a trusted advisor to utility clients delivering SAP IS U Device Management Meter Reading AMI Smart Metering and Meter to Cash transformation solutions
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and IT teams to design and implement scalable SAP IS U Device Management solutions
* Lead requirements gathering solution design configuration testing deployment and production support activities
* Configure and support device lifecycle processes including installation replacement removal exchange certification and retirement
* Support Smart Metering AMI NEM NBT DER and bi directional metering initiatives
* Work closely with SAP IS U CS Billing Meter Reading FI CA MDM EDM SAP S 4HANA and SAP BTP teams
* Support SIT UAT Cutover Go Live Hypercare and post production stabilization
* Drive process optimization automation and utility modernization initiatives
* Participate in client workshops solution demonstrations and business development activities
* Stay current with SAP S 4HANA Utilities UC4G Smart Grid AMI IoT and SAP BTP innovations
* If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey this is the place for you

  

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

  

* Technical Master Data Device Categories Device Info Records Register Groups and Installation Structures
* Device Installation Removal Replacement Exchange Certification and Meter Inventory Management
* Technical Expertise BAdIs User Exits Enhancements BRF Workflow Configuration and BPEM
* Performance optimization and coordination with ABAP development teams
* Integration Experience SAP IS U Customer Service CS SAP IS U Meter Reading MR SAP IS U Billing Invoicing SAP FI CA SAP MDM EDM SAP S 4HANA Utilities SAP Asset Management EAM PM SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite AMI Platforms HES APIs and Cloud Integrations

  

**Additional Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

  

* 5 years of SAP IS U Device Management experience across implementation enhancement rollout migration and support projects
* Experience across Electricity Gas Water and Multi Utility environments
* Smart Grid AMI IoT and Renewable Energy Programs
* SAP Datasphere SAP Analytics Cloud SAC and AI enabled utility solutions
* Agile Scrum delivery experience with strong stakeholder and client management skills
* Location of posting Infosys Ltd
* is committed to ensuring you have the best experience throughout your journey with us
* We currently have open positions in a number of locations
* across India Bangalore Pune Hyderabad Chennai Chandigarh Trivandrum Indore Nagpur Mangalore Noida Bhubaneswar Kolkata Coimbatore Mumbai Jaipur
* While we work in
* accordance with business requirements we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice where possible

  

**Preferred Skills:**
---------------------


SAP Industry Solution\-\>SAP Utilities (SAP ISU)\-\>SAP IS\-UTILITIES Device Management (SAP ISU DM)
